stem: During an I-PASS handoff, what should the receiving nurse do during the “Synthesis by Receiver” step?

options.A: Summarize the information, ask clarifying questions, and restate key action items to confirm understanding.
options.B: Remain silent and avoid repeating information so the handoff is shorter.
options.C: Delay all questions until after the outgoing nurse has left the unit.
options.D: Replace the written and verbal handoff with a medication list only.

rationale: In the TeamSTEPPS I-PASS structure, the final element is Synthesis by Receiver. The receiver summarizes what was heard, asks questions, and restates key action items so misunderstandings can be identified before responsibility transfers.
educational_objective: Apply the Synthesis by Receiver component of a structured handoff.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality, TeamSTEPPS
